result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a couple of visible layout and readability issues, primarily around content being obscured by the fixed bottom navigation and low-contrast promotional text.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is visibly cut off and continues underneath the fixed bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content or ensure the fixed navigation does not overlap restaurant cards.

issues.description: The white promotional text in the pale green offer banner has low contrast, especially the secondary line.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text or a darker banner treatment to meet readable contrast levels while preserving the promotional styling.

issues.description: The horizontal category and restaurant carousels show partially clipped items at the right edge without an obvious scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Keep the intentional carousel clipping but add a subtle fade, partial-card cue, or other indication that more content is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The right edge of the horizontal content feels abruptly cropped, with the partially visible category pill and restaurant card touching the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Apply a small trailing inset or fade mask to make the carousel boundary feel more deliberate.
